question.text: Balance with Brokers in F&O Margin Account is classified in Cat III AIF books as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.2, margin balances with brokers are treated as Assets in NAV computation; gains/losses adjust the asset balance. The Trap: Liability/equity/off-BS classification is incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Key accounting detail for derivatives-heavy Cat III AIFs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Reconcile broker margin balances weekly — brokers restate values often.
